name: Madhya Pradesh Today Media Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2010, Madhya Pradesh Today Media Ltd is in the business of publication of newspaper and media related advertisement[1]
keyPoints:
Product Profile:[1][2]
Company's Pradesh Today is the first Evening Daily Newspaper of the Madhya Pradesh which is providing all its 12 pages colored and in an international size form of newspaper. It also introduced Morning Daily newspaper in Madhya Pradesh and is the only newspaper having both morning and evening editions simultaneously. At present, Pradesh Today is present in cities like Bhopal, Indore, Gwalior, Jabalpur, etc. Company is planning to enter newspaper in other Indian States

pros: Stock is trading at 0.47 times its book value
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -4.49% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 6.69% over last 3 years.
Company has high debtors of 242 days.
